name: B10-0063/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION OF CENSURE ON THE COMMISSION MOTION OF CENSURE ON THE COMMISSION
part_text:
A group of Members of the European Parliament is asking Parliament to formally censure the European Commission. They say the Commission pushed through the EU-Mercosur trade deal despite opposition from farmers, national parliaments and Parliament itself, and split the deal into two parts to get around national parliaments. They argue the deal exposes European farmers to unfair competition from products that do not meet EU standards. The motion does not change any law by itself; it is a formal request to remove the Commission.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament would have to vote to censure the Commission.
- **Who it affects:** The Commission, European farmers, and the EU-Mercosur trade deal.
- **What happens next:** The motion goes to a plenary vote; if passed, the Commission must resign.
